body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The archived PR485 composition screen names dependencies in an old workspace, so its five saved variants and price comparison were not independently replayable from the archive alone. This research consolidation adds an offline checker binding the historical selection's Git blob, seven entrance promotions, two literal words, and both aggregate prices. It confirms the recorded no-gain outcome; no new kappa or physical hosting admission is claimed.

The checker reproduces all 955 abstract input columns, the distinct 4,144/4,147-call local profiles, the 21/84-replica assignments, and both exact moment brackets with the inherited fallback charge. Its positive-binomial arithmetic imports no historical moment engine. Original archive evidence and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/pr485-price-reconciliation/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/pr485-price-reconciliation/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_PR485_ARCHIVED_AGGREGATE_PRICES`, followed by 20 passing tests. Local CPython 3.14.6 and 3.9.6, independent rational frame checks, exact power controls, semantic corruption controls, relocated replay, receipt regeneration, and selected-record checks pass. No hosted Linux pass is claimed at submission.

Base: `2921874911956718fcaaaf9396fe8267b3cfa9f0`; OS seed 98. SOURCE.json pins 36 inputs and references; README documents historical heads, equations, attribution, bounded coverage, and unresolved physical obligations. PR1024 and PR1039 concern different frozen words; their pending code is not imported.

Prepared by Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
